title: Synchronization and conflict recovery
objective: Batch queued actions over weak networks, preserve failures, replay in creation order and use stable event IDs.
guardrails: Current conflict contract is ordered idempotent replay for one anonymous local learner key. Strong multi-device merge/versioning and durable server receipts are out of scope.
exitCriteria: retry does not duplicate an event
records remain sorted by creation time.
prototypeBoundary: This phase uses the Phase 09–17 prototype contracts. Database persistence and production auth are not claimed.
